Ulsan vs Buriram United: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of the AFC Champions League Elite group stage match, as one of the giants of Korean football, Ulsan, hosts the champions of Thailand, Buriram United. This is a clash between a clear favorite and a 'dark horse,' where the hosts will have not only class but also a huge head-to-head advantage on their side.

Kick-off: November 26, 2025, 10:00 UTC (13:00 MSK) Stadium: Ulsan Munsu Football Stadium, Ulsan Competition: AFC Champions League Elite

Ulsan vs Buriram United: Match Preview

Ulsan, a multiple winner of the AFC Champions League, enters the match as the undisputed favorite. The Korean 'Tigers' are traditionally very strong at home and will be looking to secure a convincing victory to put themselves in a comfortable position in the group. Buriram United, who dominates their domestic league, will face a major test. The visitors will try to put up a fight, but their dreadful record in matches against Ulsan makes this task almost impossible.

Team Form and Analysis

Ulsan (South Korea)

The Korean giants are known for their athletic, fast, and tactically astute football. At home, Ulsan plays with particular aggression, relying on high pressing and quick attacks. The team has won all four of their previous head-to-head encounters with Buriram, giving them a huge psychological advantage.

Buriram United (Thailand)

The Thai champions rely on technical players and team play. However, the 'Thunder Castle' has historically struggled in away matches against top clubs from Korea and Japan. The main task for Buriram will be to withstand the initial onslaught from the hosts and try to keep a clean sheet for as long as possible.

Head-to-Head Statistics

The statistics are entirely in Ulsan's favor. The Korean club has won all four of its head-to-head meetings with Buriram United. The last two games, which took place in 2018, ended in decisive victories for Ulsan (6-2 at home and 3-1 away). These results clearly demonstrate the difference in class between the two teams.

The difference in class, league quality, and total dominance in head-to-head meetings make Ulsan the absolute favorite.

  • Goals Prediction: Ulsan Individual Total Over 2.5. The 'Tigers' scored 9 goals in their last two head-to-head encounters, and they are capable of repeating that high-scoring performance at home.

Lion City Sailors vs Persib Bandung: Match Preview

For 'The Sailors,' a victory in this home match is a key objective on their path to advancing from the group. Team Form and Analysis

Lion City Sailors (Singapore)

On their artificial turf at Jalan Besar Stadium, 'The Sailors' play with particular confidence and are very productive. The main task for the hosts will be to control the ball and exploit the weaknesses in the Indonesian team's defense.

Persib Bandung (Indonesia)

Despite their underdog status, Persib is capable of causing problems for any opponent through their dedication and the experience of their leaders, such as David da Silva and Marc Klok.

Shanghai Shenhua vs Vissel Kobe: Match Preview

Shanghai Shenhua, one of the giants of Chinese football, enters the match needing to secure points at home to ensure their passage to the knockout stages. For the 'Blue Devils,' home games in the Champions League are of decisive importance. Vissel Kobe, known for their technical and combination-based football, will travel to Shanghai aiming to prove the superiority of the Japanese J.League. Welcome to the live broadcast of a historic 5th round group stage match in the AFC Champions League Two. The champion of Tajikistan, Istiqlol Dushanbe, hosts one of the main tournament favorites, Saudi Arabia's Al Nassr, led by Cristiano Ronaldo. For the hosts, this is a match for prestige and a chance to cause a sensation, while for the visitors, it's another step on the path to the trophy.

Kick-off: November 26, 2025, 13:45 UTC (16:45 MSK) Stadium: Pamir Stadium, Dushanbe Competition: AFC Champions League Two

Istiqlol Dushanbe vs Al Nassr: Match Preview

The teams approach this match with different objectives. Al Nassr is the undisputed group leader, having won all their previous matches and secured a spot in the knockout stages ahead of schedule. Istiqlol, in turn, is fighting for the second spot, which offers a chance to qualify from the group. The first-leg match in Riyadh ended in a convincing 3-1 victory for Al Nassr, but Istiqlol managed to put up a decent fight and even opened the scoring.

Team Form and Analysis

Istiqlol Dushanbe

The 'Lions' are the undisputed leaders of Tajik football. At home, with the support of their fans, Istiqlol is capable of challenging any opponent. The team will rely on an organized defense, commitment, and fast counter-attacks, where striker Manuchekhr Dzhalilov is the main threat.

Al Nassr

The 'Knights of Najd' boast one of the strongest squads in Asia with a wealth of world-class stars such as Cristiano Ronaldo, Sadio Mané, and Marcelo Brozović. Given that the task of qualifying from the group has already been accomplished, coach Jorge Jesus may opt for squad rotation, giving a chance to reserve players. However, even with such a lineup, Al Nassr is several classes above their opponent.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Istiqlol (5-4-1): Yatimov; Kartashyan, Gogoua, Orozco, Novikov, Islomov; A. Dzhalilov, Panjshanbe, Beganović, Sulaymonov; M. Dzhalilov.
  • Al Nassr (4-2-3-1): Al-Aqidi; Al-Ghannam, Laporte, Al-Amri, Telles; Brozović, Al-Khaibari; Talisca, Otávio, Mané; Ronaldo.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Although Al Nassr has already secured their tournament objectives and may not field their strongest lineup, they remain the clear favorites. The difference in player quality is too vast.

  • Main Prediction: Al Nassr to Win. Even with a second-string squad, the Saudi giants should defeat the champions of Tajikistan due to their superior individual skill.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. Al Nassr plays attacking football regardless of the lineup, and Istiqlol, with the support of their home crowd, will try to score a consolation goal.

This is an intriguing clash between one of the giants of Russian football and a sensational debutant that has already established itself as an extremely resilient opponent.

Kick-off: November 26, 2025, 15:00 UTC (18:00 MSK) Stadium: VEB Arena, Moscow Competition: Russian Cup, RPL Path Quarter-final (First Leg)

CSKA Moskva vs Dynamo Makhachkala: Match Preview

This will be the first official meeting between the clubs. CSKA, one of the tournament favorites, will be looking to prove their superiority on home turf and build a comfortable lead before the second leg. Dynamo Makhachkala, known for its impenetrable defense, will try to cause the biggest upset in its history and leave Moscow with an acceptable result. For the Army Men, this match is a step towards the trophy, while for the Makhachkala side, it's a historic event.

Team Form and Analysis

CSKA Moskva

The 'Army Men,' under Marko Nikolić, display a pragmatic and very organized style of football. The team boasts one of the best defensive lines in the league, while the championship's top scorer, Fedor Chalov, shines in attack. At home, CSKA will play on the front foot and will try to break down the opponent's packed defense from the first minutes to avoid a nervy finish.

Dynamo Makhachkala

Khasanbi Bidzhiyev's team has become the main revelation of the season thanks to its tactical discipline and organized defensive play. Dynamo will rely on a tight defense and fast counter-attacks, hoping for their chance on set pieces. No top club has managed to break down Makhachkala's defense this season, which promises serious difficulties for the Army Men.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • ЦСКА 3-4-2-1: Akinfeev; Diveev, Rocha, Moisés; Gajić, Zdjelar, Méndez, Kellven; Fayzullaev, Dávila; Chalov.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Despite Dynamo Makhachkala's resilience, CSKA are the undisputed favorites at home. The difference in the class of attacking players and the home-stadium advantage should be decisive.

  • Main Prediction: CSKA to Win. The Army Men should be able to overcome the sensational newcomer on their home turf to build a lead before the second leg.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. Dynamo has one of the best defenses in the league and will play a closed style of football. It will not be easy for the Army Men to break down their defensive lines. A tight, tactical battle is expected.
